## Definition of Done (docs/standards/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria covered by tests
- [ ] `pnpm validate` and affected lint/typecheck/test pass
- [ ] `/review` run — no open Blocker/Major
- [ ] Docs / ADR / runbook updated
- [ ] Flag + rollout plan (user-visible changes)
- [ ] i18n EN/FR, a11y, analytics events (user-visible changes)
- [ ] Migration & rollback notes (server changes)
- [ ] `/balance-check` (outcome-affecting gameplay changes)
- [ ] Privacy / security review (personal data, auth, payments, ranked results)
